stringbuilder-getchunks.title: Read StringBuilder content without copying with GetChunks
stringbuilder-getchunks.short: Process built text chunk by chunk
stringbuilder-getchunks.summary: GetChunks exposes StringBuilder content as a sequence of ReadOnlyMemory<char> chunks.
stringbuilder-getchunks.why: It can process already-built text without first duplicating the whole buffer with ToString.
stringbuilder-getchunks.tips: Do not modify the StringBuilder while enumerating its chunks.

array-constrainedcopy.title: Preserve destination consistency with Array.ConstrainedCopy
array-constrainedcopy.short: Avoid partial destination updates when copying fails
array-constrainedcopy.summary: ConstrainedCopy provides rollback semantics when an array copy fails because an element cannot be assigned.
array-constrainedcopy.why: It is useful when a partially modified destination array would violate an invariant.
array-constrainedcopy.tips: For ordinary same-type copies, Array.Copy usually communicates the intent more simply.

executioncontext-suppressflow.title: Suppress ExecutionContext flow deliberately
executioncontext-suppressflow.short: Keep ambient state out of independent background work
executioncontext-suppressflow.summary: ExecutionContext.SuppressFlow temporarily prevents automatic propagation of context such as AsyncLocal values.
executioncontext-suppressflow.why: Long-lived independent work sometimes must not inherit request-scoped ambient state.
executioncontext-suppressflow.tips: Normal async code usually needs context flow; use this only at deliberate infrastructure boundaries.

memorymarshal-read-write.title: Read and write value types with MemoryMarshal
memorymarshal-read-write.short: Move compatible value types directly to and from spans
memorymarshal-read-write.summary: MemoryMarshal.Read and Write access non-reference value types in contiguous byte storage.
memorymarshal-read-write.why: Low-level formats can avoid temporary arrays when mapping values to bytes.
memorymarshal-read-write.tips: Verify struct layout and endianness explicitly against the external format.

runtimehelpers-reference-contains.title: Detect references in generic types with RuntimeHelpers
runtimehelpers-reference-contains.short: Ask whether T contains managed references
runtimehelpers-reference-contains.summary: RuntimeHelpers.IsReferenceOrContainsReferences<T> reports whether T itself or any of its fields contains managed references.
runtimehelpers-reference-contains.why: Low-level buffers can use it to decide when reference-sensitive clearing is required.
runtimehelpers-reference-contains.tips: This is primarily an infrastructure optimization rather than an everyday application API.

gc-memory-info.title: Inspect GC state with GC.GetGCMemoryInfo
gc-memory-info.short: Use runtime heap information for diagnostics
gc-memory-info.summary: GetGCMemoryInfo reports diagnostic information such as heap size and memory load around garbage collection.
gc-memory-info.why: Memory investigations can use runtime evidence instead of guessing from process behavior.
gc-memory-info.tips: Treat the values as diagnostic signals rather than hard universal thresholds for forcing collections.

json-serialize-utf8bytes.title: Serialize JSON directly to UTF-8 bytes
json-serialize-utf8bytes.short: Produce byte[] without an intermediate JSON string
json-serialize-utf8bytes.summary: SerializeToUtf8Bytes serializes a value directly into a UTF-8 JSON byte array.
json-serialize-utf8bytes.why: Network and file paths that ultimately need UTF-8 can skip an intermediate string representation.
json-serialize-utf8bytes.tips: For very large or incremental output, prefer a Stream or Utf8JsonWriter.

tarfile-create-directory.title: Archive a directory with TarFile.CreateFromDirectory
tarfile-create-directory.short: Create a TAR archive from a directory tree
tarfile-create-directory.summary: TarFile.CreateFromDirectory creates a TAR archive from the contents of a directory.
tarfile-create-directory.why: It avoids manually creating every archive entry for whole-directory backups or packaging.
tarfile-create-directory.tips: Review destination paths, links, and the trust boundary of the input tree.

brotlistream-compress.title: Compress streams with BrotliStream
brotlistream-compress.short: Apply Brotli without buffering the entire payload
brotlistream-compress.summary: BrotliStream wraps another stream and performs Brotli compression or decompression while data flows.
brotlistream-compress.why: Large payloads do not need to become one giant intermediate byte array.
brotlistream-compress.tips: Choose leaveOpen and disposal order deliberately, and balance compression level against throughput.

randomnumbergenerator-getint32.title: Generate unbiased secure integers with RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32
randomnumbergenerator-getint32.short: Use cryptographic randomness for security-sensitive choices
randomnumbergenerator-getint32.summary: GetInt32 returns an integer in a requested range using a cryptographically secure random source.
randomnumbergenerator-getint32.why: Tokens and security-sensitive random choices should not depend on Random.Shared.
randomnumbergenerator-getint32.tips: Use Random for simulations and games when cryptographic unpredictability is unnecessary.
